ZAMEEN DELTA (PRIVATE) LIMITED
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2023
1

COMPANY AND ITS OPERATIONS

1.1

Corporate and general information
Zameen Delta (Private) Limited Company ("the Company") was incorporated on 18 February 2019 as a Private Limited
Company under ("the Act"). The Company's principal activity is to engage in the business of development of all types
of real estate including commercial markets and multi stories building, shopping centers etc. The registered office of the
Company is situated at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The Company is a subsidiary of
Zameen Developments (Private) Limited ("the Parent Company"), a Company incorporated in Pakistan. The ultimate
parent of the company is Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited, a Company incorporated in United Arab Emirates.
The Company has incurred loss of Rs. 23,944,063 (2022: Rs. 13,419,954) and its accumulated losses as at the
reporting date amounts to Rs. 62,643,364 (2022: Rs. 38,699,301) resulting in a negative equity of Rs. 62,641,364
(2022: Rs. 38,697,301) as at that date. The Parent Company has committed to provide financial support to the
Company, enabling the Company to continue its operations as going concern and fulfil all of its financial obligation.
Based on which the financial statements of the Company are prepared on going concern basis.

1.2

The Company holds 33.33% share in ZUI Investments (the Firm), a partnership firm which was established on 19 April
2019 in Pakistan. The firm was registered with the Registrar of Firms under section 58 (I) of the Partnership Act, 1932
on 26 October 2018. Its primary place of business and registered office is located at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam
Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The principal activity of the Firm is to undertake, manage, market and sell the project,
"Zameen Ace Mall" on the project land located in Islamabad. The Company's owners / directors are also Partners in the
Firm. As at 30 June 2023, the project is under development phase.

1.3

The Company holds 20% share in V4 Capital (the Firm), a partnership firm which was established on 22 October 2019
in Pakistan. The firm was registered with the Registrar of Firms under section 58 (I) of the Partnership Act, 1932 on 10
May 2019. Its primary place of business and registered office is located at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg
III, Lahore. The principal activity of the Firm is to undertake, manage, market and sell the project, "Zameen Ace Homes"
on the project land located in Islamabad. The Company's owners / directors are also Partners in the Firm. As at 30 June
2023, the project is under development phase.

2

BASIS OF PREPARATION

2.1

Statement of compliance
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the accounting and reporting standards as
applicable in Pakistan. The accounting and reporting standards applicable in Pakistan comprise of:
- International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS Standards) issued by the International Accounting Standards Board
(IASB) as notified under the Companies Act, 2017; and
- Provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017.
Where provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017 differ from the IFRS standards, the
provisions of and directives of the Companies Act, 2017 have been followed.

2.2

Basis of measurement
These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention unless otherwise stated.

2.3

Functional and presentation currency
These financial statements are presented in Pak Rupees, which is the Company’s functional currency. All figures have
been rounded off to the nearest Rupee, unless otherwise stated.

2.4

Standards, interpretations and amendments to published accounting standards
The following are new and amended standards and interpretations effective for annual period beginning on July 01,
2022, as listed below:
